summary: The uri test validates that a string is a URI, optionally restricted to a list of schemes.
questions: How do I validate that a string is a valid URI?
How do I check a URI uses http or https only?

answer_card.title: uri test
answer_card.answer_md: `value is uri` checks the string conforms to the URI standard; `uri(schemes=[...])` also requires one of the given schemes.
